tools.name: minta_dipertemukan

tools.name: cek_jodoh
tools.description: Check your matches with your private token (token_kelola as seller or token_pembeli as buyer). The other side's contact appears once both agree.

tools.name: setujui_jodoh
tools.description: Approve (or decline with setuju=false) a match using your private token.

tools.name: lapor_transaksi
tools.description: Seller reports a completed deal from an OCKLU match; records the 7% commission invoice.

tools.name: daftar_afiliasi
tools.description: Become an OCKLU affiliate: get a referral code that can be passed as the optional ref parameter of buy links. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "hypermarket" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tertau_baca, daftar_afiliasi, komunitas_baca · Private data: tertau_tulis, pasang_jualan, cari_penawaran, minta_dipertemukan, cek_jodoh, setujui_jodoh, lapor_transaksi, komunitas_baca, komunitas_tulis · Public sink: tawar_harga, sampaikan_kebutuhan, komunitas_baca, komunitas_tulis, data_ocklu · Destructive: detail_produk.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tertau_baca, daftar_afiliasi, komunitas_baca · Private data: tertau_tulis, pasang_jualan, cari_penawaran, minta_dipertemukan, cek_jodoh, setujui_jodoh, lapor_transaksi, komunitas_baca, komunitas_tulis · Public sink: tawar_harga, sampaikan_kebutuhan, komunitas_baca, komunitas_tulis, data_ocklu · Destructive: detail_produk

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "komunitas_baca" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
